envelope.description: Correlate update confirmation in VS Code and JetBrains

body.title: Correlate update confirmation in VS Code and JetBrains
body.summary: Both IDEs confirm managed transactions only on their acknowledged update ID and show pending confirmation when the outcome cannot be retrieved. Keep the existing fallback for legacy responses.
acceptanceChecks: Changed installedCommit and unrelated terminal results do not confirm a managed update
Both IDEs handle rollback, lost acknowledgement and a legacy daemon

tests.name: Correlated update outcomes ignore unrelated terminal records and changed installedCommit
Candidate status projects the prior commit during validation and a later rollback in both IDE confirmation flows
Lost update acknowledgement does not trigger an automatic duplicate request
